content: Ku huoŋgu-na, miɛ mi ne da gbɛrɛ naŋ temma dɔrɔ‑i-na: ciɛŋo naŋo. Uu naa dii bãanyufelle‑i joŋgor temma, aa haa u gbeini‑i cɛiŋo-na aa dii nyantuoluo baa mɔɛŋa cĩncieluo baa a hãi yuɔ.
Kusũŋgu waa-yuɔ a hi homma. Kuŋ bilaa-yo ta ku jaŋ-yo, wuɔ tuɔ kaasĩŋ.
Miɛ mi ne tiraa da gbɛrɛ naŋo dɔrɔ‑i-na: Jũŋo naŋo da dãa baa yunni niehãi baa yiɛŋa cĩncieluo! Nyantuolbaa-ba waa u yunni-na hiere.
U pelieŋgu pir mɔɛŋa‑i yiɛŋgu diei nanna hĩɛma-na. Da ba calnu mɔɛŋa‑i sɔmma siɛi, u pirii sɔmma diei nanna. Wuɔ jo ji yiɛra ciɛŋ daayo caaŋgu-na wuɔ duɔ bɔrɔ u hĩŋ biloŋo‑i.

Ciɛŋ wuɔ bɔrɔ naacombiloŋo. Uŋ bi buɔra, baa biɛ biloŋo‑i kã baa-yo ka jĩna-yuɔ Diiloŋo caaŋgu-na. U waa tĩɛna u fɔ̃ŋgɔ̃taaŋ-teterre-na. Naacombiloŋ daayo yaa saaya u sire waa nilɛiŋa‑i hiere a yuŋgu-na. U ka sire ce u fɔ̃ŋgũɔ‑i baa kɔlluŋ-bũɔle.
Baŋ biyaa biloŋo‑i ta baa-yo, nyuŋ wuɔ gbar suur hĩɛŋ-nu. Diiloŋo naa tigiiŋ terieŋgu naŋgu dii hĩɛŋgu-na duɔ ka fiɛ-yo yinni nuɔsiba niediei komuɔŋa siɛi.
Huɔŋgu faŋgu-na, bɛrru nandu sire dɔrɔ‑i-na. Misɛl‑i
baa u napɔpuɔrbiemba yaa kãa ka suuye jũŋ daayo‑i baa u baamba‑i.
Baŋ daa ba-naa dumaaŋo-na, baa yar jũŋo‑i baa u baamba‑i, a ce dumaaŋo-na ba saa gbãa da ba tĩɛna dɔrɔ‑i-na.
Ba siɛ-yo nanna hĩɛma-na. U yaa jĩɛbĩncɔiŋo‑i. U yerre yaa *Sitãni, dinande yaa *Bigãarãŋo. U yaa tãalãaŋ nuɔmba‑i hĩɛma-na hiere. Ba siɛ-yo nanna baa u pɔpuɔrbiemba‑i hiere hĩɛma-na.
Miɛ mi ne da molo piiye dɔrɔ‑i-na da gbagaga wuɔ:

content.text: I Diiloŋo pigãaŋ u fɔ̃ŋgɔ̃tesĩnni‑i baa u nellentesĩnni‑i.
Umaŋ taa u cãl i baamba‑i bãaŋgu‑i baa isuɔŋgu‑i Diiloŋo yaaŋga-na,
baa Diiloŋ-nelma maŋ hilaa i baamba nunni-na,
Ba hĩɛrã kuliiŋgu‑i ŋaa ku sa jaŋ-ba.
Terieŋgu faŋgu-na, namaa namaŋ dii dɔrɔ‑i-na hiere, taa na nyɛ.
Ŋga namaa namaŋ dii hĩɛma-na, baa hũmma-na, sũlma haraa-nɛi!
Sitãni hiiriiye kã na wulaa baa hɔdulle,
u suyaa wuɔ u yinni saa tĩɛ bɔi.»

content: Jũŋoŋ juɔ'a u ne da u fɛrɛ hĩɛma-na, wuɔ sire cu cɛhuonaciɛŋ daayo huoŋ-nu.
Baa hã ciɛŋo‑i kuɔcurɔ bũncɛmmu hãi, u yuul ka diire dii *hĩɛŋgu-na baŋ tigiiŋ terieŋgu maŋ hã-yo u duɔ ka tĩɛna ce bieŋa siɛi baa boluoŋgu jĩɛŋo baa da u yufelle.
Uŋ yuulii ka diire dumaaŋo-na, jĩɛŋo wuosa hũmma, kuɔ pãŋ ce nuoraaŋgu ta ku bũŋ da ku ka wuo ciɛŋo‑i.
Hĩɛma yaŋ-yo aa naa yiɛrnu hũŋ daama yaaŋga-na, maa bũŋ jo ji suur hiere. Hĩɛma bir suuye.
Jũŋo huɔŋga fũnuŋ du baa ciɛŋo‑i. Bisãlmba namba waa baa ciɛŋo‑i. Jũŋo gũunu ka tuɔ gãŋ baa ba yaa‑i. Bisãlŋ daaba yaa bamaŋ nuɔŋ Diiloŋo nuŋgu‑i aa bel Yesu nelma‑i nammu hãi.
Ku huoŋgu-na, jũŋo jo ji yiɛra dãmmaŋ-nuoraaŋgu nuŋgu-na tuɔ ne.
